digest.component_or_area: reconciler bridge and canary CI workflows
propositions: Reconciler bridge cron schedule must transition from 20-minute cadence (*/20 * * * *) to uniform 40-minute cadence using a three-entry 2-hour cycle
Opt-in continuous reconcile chain must self-tune pacing by recording pass start epoch and sleeping for elapsed duration (capped at 900s, skipped above 1800s) before re-dispatch
Canary workflow schedule must transition from hourly (0 * * * *) to 2-hourly (0 */2 * * *) cadence
Canary staleness alert window must double from 2 hours to 4 hours, maintaining 3x cadence margin and preserving alert semantics
Tests must assert 40-minute uniform gaps across three-entry cron cycle and verify pacing guards (unset epoch, elapsed threshold, sleep cap)
All documentation, comments, and test fixtures naming old cadences (*/20, hourly, 2h window) must be rewritten to reflect new values
